Raft membership reconfiguration, snapshot, log compaction, leader transfer
tests: `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_AtomicMixedBatchSucceeds`, `TestProposeJointConfChange_AtomicRemovalCommitsAndConverges`, `TestJointConsensus_FullQuorumFlip_NoSplitBrain`, `TestInstallSnapshot_StragglerCatchUpViaCompaction`, leadertransfer_stress_test.go (prior rounds); `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_AddLearnerSucceeds`, `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_RemoveVoterOnLearnerFailsClosed`, `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_RemoveLearnerOnVoterFailsClosed`, `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_PromoteLearnerSucceeds`, `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_PromoteLearnerOnVoterFailsClosed`, `TestValidateConfChangeBatch_RejectsAllLearnerResult`, `TestConfChange_LearnerReplicatesButNeverCountsTowardQuorum`, `TestConfChange_PromoteLearnerMakesItCountTowardQuorum` (learner/voter role distinction); `TestHandleInstallSnapshot_CorruptedBytesFailsClosed`, `TestHandleInstallSnapshot_TruncatedFailsClosed`, `TestHandleInstallSnapshot_StaleSnapshotInstallAttemptRefused`, `TestHandleInstallSnapshot_ValidSnapshotStillInstallsCleanly` (adversarial snapshot tests); `TestBecomeLeader_ResumesStrandedJointConsensusTransition`, `TestBecomeLeader_DoesNotResumeWhenNoJointTransitionIsActive` (leader-during-reconfiguration)
note: was marked OPEN/no-test in the v7.12.0 matrix, which was stale: atomic joint membership changes (add/remove/mixed batch), leader transfer under stress, and snapshot install + straggler-catchup-via-compaction are all implemented and tested. This round closed the three specific gaps the caveat named honestly, all with real code changes, not relabeling: (1) an explicit learner/voter role distinction now exists -- confchange.go gains ADD_LEARNER/REMOVE_LEARNER/PROMOTE_LEARNER, backed by a real Node.learners set and a votingPeersLocked() helper that PreVote, RequestVote solicitation, CheckQuorum, ReadIndex and non-joint commit-majority calculation all now consult; a learner replicates fully but never counts toward any vote or commit majority (proven by partitioning one away mid-test and confirming the cluster still commits). Honestly still narrower than it could be: true two-phase joint consensus (ENTER_JOINT/LEAVE_JOINT) does not yet compose with learners -- documented at the one call site that matters (hasQuorumIndexLocked), not silently assumed. (2) adversarial corrupted/truncated/stale-snapshot tests now exist, using a real checksum-verifying Snapshotter fixture (sumFSM's own Restore silently resets on bad input rather than erroring, so it could not have proven this) -- all three fail closed with the underlying HandleInstallSnapshot machinery, which turned out to already be correct; these tests are the first real evidence of that. (3) a named leader-during-reconfiguration test found and closed a real gap: applyCommitted's own comment admitted proposing LEAVE_JOINT once ENTER_JOINT commits was best-effort and a new leader would have to re-drive it itself -- nothing did, so a leader failing in that exact window left every subsequent leader stuck on the stricter dual-majority quorum forever. becomeLeader now resumes a stranded transition it inherits. Honestly scoped: this is proven as a direct, deterministic same-package test of the mechanism (construct the stranded state, call becomeLeader, assert it resumes), not a live multi-node cluster killing a real leader mid-transition -- several such cluster-level attempts proved unreliable to make deterministic in this sandbox for reasons that turned out to be about Raft's own liveness properties (PreVote's leaderLive check, joint consensus's zero-slack dual quorum once a member is lost) rather than about the fix itself, and that limitation is recorded honestly rather than papered over with a flaky test.

tests: `TestDrainAcrossAllFiveR050Sources`, `TestQualityVectorReflectsRejections` (pkg/connector); per-source `TestDecode_ValidFixtureRoundtrips`, `TestDecode_MalformedJSONFailsClosed`, `TestDecode_TruncatedJSONFailsClosed`, `TestDecode_WrongSchemaFailsClosed`, `TestDecode_MissingRequiredFieldFailsClosed`, `TestDecode_SemanticallyInvalidFailsClosed`, `TestSimulatedConnector_ContentHashDedup`, `TestSimulatedNeverAcceptedAsLive` (sar, bol, insurance, payment); `TestNormalizedEvent_ToOntologyEvidence_ValidAISObservation`, `TestConnector_MalformedMessages_RejectedAndCounted` (aisstream, pre-existing AIS contract)
note: was genuinely OPEN (pkg/connector did not exist for 4 of the 5 named source types; only AIS had prior treatment via pkg/connector/aisstream). Closed for real: pkg/connector/{sar,bol,insurance,payment} each parse raw payloads, structurally validate them (malformed/truncated/wrong-schema/missing-field all fail closed before any semantic check runs), semantically validate them, and canonicalize into pkg/evidence/ontology.Evidence (TypeSARObservation, TypeTradeRecord, TypeDocument, TypeFinancialRecord respectively; AIS already used TypeAISObservation). pkg/connector.Drain composes pkg/blockers/livedata's existing FeedConnector/Pipeline (content-hash dedup, anti-replay, LIVE-refusal) with each source's new Decoder rather than duplicating any of that machinery. No live provider access exists in this sandbox for any of the five sources: every connector is SIMULATED-mode only, and TestSimulatedNeverAcceptedAsLive (one per new source package) plus TestDrainAcrossAllFiveR050Sources prove a SIMULATED connector's record tagged LIVE is refused, exactly mirroring livedata's own invariant. LIVE mode is structurally supported (Drain does not special-case FeedConnector.Mode(), only livedata.Pipeline's own check does) but never fabricated.

title: Qualification evidence freshness gate reporting BLOCKED_STALE_EVIDENCE by name
note: PHASE E2 / P0-7. PASS requires report.commit == release.commit, source_hash, artifact_root and binary_hash all matching, and valid_until >= qualification time; anything else is the named BLOCKED_STALE_EVIDENCE, never a generic failure. A release that declares no value to compare against fails closed rather than silently passing.

title: Readiness engine separation: ENGINEERING / INTERNAL / EXTERNAL / FINAL as four distinct axes per gate
note: PHASE E3 / P0-8. Axes are DERIVED from the same evidence artifacts `EffectiveStatus` reads; there is no setter that writes PASS into an axis. Retrofitted onto all 8 externally-blocked mandatory gates: their ENGINEERING axis is backed by a real in-process `pkg/blockers/orchestrator.RunAll` execution and their INTERNAL axis by the committed in-sandbox drill logs, while Status, Satisfied, Assess and the release Verdict are provably untouched (`TestAxisSeparationNeverAdvancesTheGateItself`). No amount of internal evidence can move the EXTERNAL axis.
